record.question: The microscopic examination of the urine sediment is an indispensable part of the evaluation of patients with:
record.explanation: Answer D: All of the above. Urine sediment microscopy can add clinically useful findings in proteinuria, hematuria, and suspected nephrolithiasis (e.g., casts, cells, crystals), although its role depends on the specific clinical question. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK302/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK507821/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
